items.title: Chancellor rejects calls to raise Capital Gains Tax in Budget
items.summary: Influential Labour figures had been pushing for equalising CGT and income tax, but critics have said this could drive wealthy people out of Britain.

items.title: We asked teens what schools should teach them about work. This is what they said
items.summary: Teenagers say they want more work experience at school and opportunities to improve their communication skills.

items.title: Curfew imposed in parts of central Paris and other cities after rioting across France
items.summary: The country's interior minister admits that police "lost control" in some cities following a weekend of riots.

items.title: Watch: Clean up begins after French riots but police remain
items.summary: Outside of Paris, Marseille saw some of the worst damage, with shop owners reporting more than 600 premises having been looted.

items.title: Burnham vows end to 'rip-off parking charges' under new rules
items.summary: Penalties are seen as too harsh on motorists who are penalised for parking on private land.

items.title: US church on frontline of battle against drug known as 'tranq'
items.summary: Synthetic opioids like fentanyl are more powerful and in plentiful supply, and they have transformed the drugs landscape.

items.title: Criminals detained in hospital set to lose benefits
items.summary: The families of the victims of Nottingham killer Valdo Calocane had been campaigning for the change.

items.title: Ukrainians dying because US restricting intelligence sharing, Zelensky adviser tells BBC
items.summary: Serhii Beskrestnov says there has not been enough time to warn people about incoming missile attacks. The White House said there had been no changes to intelligence sharing.
